lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows along the mid-flank, with the most distinct clusters situated between the primary carinae. Spot spacing increases in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming a localized grid-like pattern particularly visible in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (highlighted upper edge, shadowed lower edge), running longitudinally from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of small, lower-contrast high-luminance blobs is visible across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed along the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical high-luminance linear marks (scars) are visible: one posterior to the gill slits, and multiple parallel vertical bands located on the caudal peduncle and the base of the second dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark fusiform silhouettes are visible in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin and abdomen, indicating commensal organisms.
